# Level Indicator

```tsx
import { LevelIndicator, LevelIndicatorGroup, LevelIndicatorLabel } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Shows a level as rows of items. Mirrors the three Figma levels: Level Indicator Label adds the text around the indicator, Level Indicator sets Size and holds the groups, and each Level Indicator Group has its own Count, Active and Color.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<LevelIndicatorLabel
  labelPosition={labelPosition}
  showLabelLeft={showLabelLeft}
  labelLeft={labelLeft}
  showLabelRight={showLabelRight}
  labelRight={labelRight}
>
  <LevelIndicator size={size}>
    {renderGroups(allArgs, groups)}
  </LevelIndicator>
</LevelIndicatorLabel>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the three levels of the Figma Level Indicator:
- Level Indicator Group: Count (1 to 10 items, 4px apart) × Color. Items are 16px tall with the Small radius. Active items take the Icon/*/Display color, the others Background/Disabled/Soft.
- Level Indicator: Size (item width: Small 6px, Medium 16px, Large 28px) and the groups 12px apart. Groups=1, 2 and 3 are one, two or three children.
- Level Indicator Label: Body/Small text around the indicator, 4px away on the Top and Bottom positions, 12px on the Side ones.
- Narrower than Figma, the groups and the side labels break into lines and the items shrink.

## Rules

- Import `LevelIndicator` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
